relations.name: account_mrr_monthly
relations.comment: One row per account and complete month (dense, 2,592 rows). Pseudonymous account_key, never names or contacts. definition 1.0.0. Never treat account_key as anonymous; always use LIMIT.
relations.definition:
SELECT m.month_start,
    a.account_key,
    a.customer_segment,
    a.country_code,
    a.plan_name,
    m.ending_mrr_eur::numeric(14,2) AS ending_mrr_eur,
    s.complete_through_month,
    s.data_loaded_at_utc,
    s.quality_status
   FROM core.account_months m
     JOIN core.accounts a ON a.account_id = m.account_id
     CROSS JOIN core.load_status s
  WHERE m.month_start <= s.complete_through_month;

relations.name: data_status_by_view
relations.comment: One row per approved data view: load time (UTC), last complete month, quality gate, freshness thresholds, owner and definition version. definition 1.0.0. Read it before answering; never compute age with now().
relations.definition:
SELECT c.view_name,
    s.data_loaded_at_utc,
    s.complete_through_month,
    s.quality_status,
    c.warn_after_hours,
    c.hard_expiry_hours,
    c.owner_team,
    c.definition_version
   FROM core.serving_contracts c
     CROSS JOIN core.load_status s;

relations.name: expansion_mrr_by_country_monthly
relations.comment: One row per complete month and country (dense: 18 x 8 = 144 rows, zeros explicit). Expansion MRR in EUR. definition 1.0.0. Never compare with billing_events sums, which contain retry duplicates.
relations.definition:
WITH months AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT account_months.month_start
           FROM core.account_months
        ), countries AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT accounts.country_code
           FROM core.accounts
        ), expansion AS (
         SELECT m.month_start,
            a.country_code,
            sum(m.net_new_mrr_eur) AS expansion_mrr_eur
           FROM core.account_months m
             JOIN core.accounts a ON a.account_id = m.account_id
          WHERE m.movement_type = 'expansion'::text
          GROUP BY m.month_start, a.country_code
        )
 SELECT mo.month_start,
    c.country_code,
    COALESCE(x.expansion_mrr_eur, 0::numeric)::numeric(14,2) AS expansion_mrr_eur,
    s.complete_through_month,
    s.data_loaded_at_utc,
    s.quality_status
   FROM months mo
     CROSS JOIN countries c
     CROSS JOIN core.load_status s
     LEFT JOIN expansion x ON x.month_start = mo.month_start AND x.country_code = c.country_code
  WHERE mo.month_start <= s.complete_through_month;

relations.name: logo_churn_by_segment_quarter
relations.comment: One row per complete quarter and customer segment. Logo churn rate with its numerator and denominator. definition 1.0.0. Never average the rate across segments or quarters; recompute from the counts.
relations.definition:
WITH quarters AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT date_trunc('quarter'::text, account_months.month_start::timestamp with time zone)::date AS period_start
           FROM core.account_months
        ), bounds AS (
         SELECT quarters.period_start,
            (quarters.period_start + '3 mons'::interval)::date AS period_end_exclusive,
            (quarters.period_start - '1 mon'::interval)::date AS base_month,
            (quarters.period_start + '2 mons'::interval)::date AS last_month
           FROM quarters
        )
 SELECT b.period_start,
    b.period_end_exclusive,
    a.customer_segment,
    count(*)::integer AS starting_accounts,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.ending_mrr_eur = 0::numeric)::integer AS churned_accounts,
    round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.ending_mrr_eur = 0::numeric)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0)::numeric, 1)::numeric(5,1) AS logo_churn_rate_pct,
    s.complete_through_month,
    s.data_loaded_at_utc,
    s.quality_status
   FROM bounds b
     CROSS JOIN core.load_status s
     JOIN core.account_months st ON st.month_start = b.base_month AND st.ending_mrr_eur > 0::numeric
     JOIN core.account_months e ON e.account_id = st.account_id AND e.month_start = b.last_month
     JOIN core.accounts a ON a.account_id = st.account_id
  WHERE b.last_month <= s.complete_through_month
  GROUP BY b.period_start, b.period_end_exclusive, a.customer_segment, s.complete_through_month, s.data_loaded_at_utc, s.quality_status;

relations.name: mrr_summary_monthly
relations.comment: One row per complete calendar month, company level, EUR. Ending MRR (a level) beside its movements (changes). definition 1.0.0. Never add ending_mrr_eur across months.
relations.definition:
SELECT m.month_start,
    sum(m.ending_mrr_eur)::numeric(14,2) AS ending_mrr_eur,
    COALESCE(sum(m.ending_mrr_eur) FILTER (WHERE m.movement_type = 'new'::text), 0::numeric)::numeric(14,2) AS new_mrr_eur,
    COALESCE(sum(m.net_new_mrr_eur) FILTER (WHERE m.movement_type = 'expansion'::text), 0::numeric)::numeric(14,2) AS expansion_mrr_eur,
    COALESCE(- sum(m.net_new_mrr_eur) FILTER (WHERE m.movement_type = 'contraction'::text), 0::numeric)::numeric(14,2) AS contraction_mrr_eur,
    COALESCE(sum(m.starting_mrr_eur) FILTER (WHERE m.movement_type = 'churn'::text), 0::numeric)::numeric(14,2) AS churned_mrr_eur,
    sum(m.net_new_mrr_eur)::numeric(14,2) AS net_new_mrr_eur,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.ending_mrr_eur > 0::numeric)::integer AS active_accounts,
    s.complete_through_month,
    s.data_loaded_at_utc,
    s.quality_status
   FROM core.account_months m
     CROSS JOIN core.load_status s
  WHERE m.month_start <= s.complete_through_month
  GROUP BY m.month_start, s.complete_through_month, s.data_loaded_at_utc, s.quality_status;

    churn_calc.segment,
    churn_calc.active_start_count,
    churn_calc.churned_count,
    ROUND(churn_calc.churned_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(churn_calc.active_start_count, 0), 4) AS logo_churn_rate
FROM churn_calc
ORDER BY churn_calc.segment

definitions.ending_mrr:
- name: ending_mrr
    label: Ending MRR
    description: >-
      Monthly recurring revenue active at the last instant of a complete calendar month,
      in EUR, one row per month. Never add it across months.
    type: snapshot
    relation: analytics.mrr_summary_monthly
    expression: ending_mrr_eur
    result_grain: one row per complete calendar month
    valid_dimensions: [month_start]
    period_rule: >-
      For a quarter, return each complete month-end (three rows). If the user needs ONE
      number, return the last month-end of the period and say so. Never sum or average
      month-ends unless the question explicitly asks for an average balance.
    completeness: month_start <= complete_through_month
    additivity:
      class: semi-additive
      across_segments: sum
      across_accounts: sum
      across_time: none
      time_rollup: last_value
    unit: EUR
    precision: 0
    population: >-
      All 144 FOLDLINE business accounts; an account contributes its MRR at month end,
      or 0 if it has not started or has churned.
    inclusions:
      - Recurring subscription fees active at month end.
    exclusions:
      - Setup fees
      - Usage charges
      - Taxes
      - Subscriptions whose service ended before month end
    synonyms: [month-end mrr, closing mrr, mrr balance at month end]
    ambiguous_terms: [mrr, revenue]
    reconciliation: >-
      ending_mrr(previous month) + net_new_mrr(month) = ending_mrr(month).
      Q2 2026: 354,635 + 32,380 = 387,015.
    owner: revenue_analytics
    version: 1.0.0
    status: approved
    verified_questions: [G01, F00, F01]
    limitations:
      - Not revenue, cash collected, ARR or profit.
      - Never sum ending MRR across months.
    expected_q2_2026:
      "2026-04-01": 334675
      "2026-05-01": 344450
      "2026-06-01": 387015
definitions.net_new_mrr:
- name: net_new_mrr
    label: Net new MRR
    description: >-
      Change in MRR during a complete calendar month, in EUR: new + expansion
      - contraction - churned. One row per month. Never read it as a balance.
    type: movement
    relation: analytics.mrr_summary_monthly
    expression: net_new_mrr_eur
    formula: new_mrr_eur + expansion_mrr_eur - contraction_mrr_eur - churned_mrr_eur
    result_grain: one row per complete calendar month
    valid_dimensions: [month_start]
    period_rule: >-
      For a quarter, add the three complete monthly movements. The result equals
      ending MRR at the end of the quarter minus ending MRR at the end of the previous
      quarter. Partial months are never added.
    completeness: month_start <= complete_through_month
    additivity:
      class: additive
      across_segments: sum
      across_accounts: sum
      across_time: sum
      time_rollup: sum
    unit: EUR
    precision: 0
    sign_convention: >-
      Negative means MRR shrank during the month. April 2026 is -19,960.
    synonyms: [net mrr change, mrr movement net, net new mrr]
    ambiguous_terms: [mrr, mrr growth, revenue]
    reconciliation: >-
      sum(net_new_mrr over Q2 2026) = ending_mrr(2026-06) - ending_mrr(2026-03)
      = 387,015 - 354,635 = 32,380.
    owner: revenue_analytics
    version: 1.0.0
    status: approved
    verified_questions: [G02]
    limitations:
      - A monthly change, not a balance. Not revenue, cash or profit.
    expected_q2_2026:
      "2026-04-01": -19960
      "2026-05-01": 9775
      "2026-06-01": 42565
      quarter_total: 32380
definitions.logo_churn_rate:
- name: logo_churn_rate
    label: Logo churn rate
    description: >-
      Share of the accounts active at the start of a quarter that were no longer
      active at its end, in percent (0-100), one row per customer segment and
      quarter. Never average segment rates; recompute from the counts.
    type: ratio
    relation: analytics.logo_churn_by_segment_quarter
    numerator: churned_accounts
    denominator: starting_accounts
    expression: round(100.0 * churned_accounts / nullif(starting_accounts, 0), 1)
    result_grain: one row per customer_segment per quarter
    valid_dimensions: [period_start, period_end_exclusive, customer_segment]
    period_rule: >-
      Quarters only, as half-open ranges [period_start, period_end_exclusive). A rate
      for a longer period is recomputed from that period's own base, never built by
      averaging or adding quarterly rates.
    completeness: period_end_exclusive <= complete_through_month + 1 month
    population: >-
      Accounts active at the end of the month before period_start. Accounts that
      joined during the quarter are NOT in the base, even if they churn.
    zero_denominator: "null"
    additivity:
      class: non-additive
      across_segments: recompute_from_components
      across_time: recompute_from_components
      time_rollup: recompute_from_components
    unit: percent
    scale: 0-100
    precision: 1
    synonyms: [customer churn rate, account churn rate, logo churn]
    ambiguous_terms: [churn, churn rate]
    reconciliation: >-
      starting_accounts - churned_accounts + new accounts in the quarter
      = accounts active at the quarter's end. Q2 2026 per segment: 40 - 4 + 8 = 44.
    owner: revenue_analytics
    version: 1.0.0
    status: approved
    verified_questions: [G03, Q04]
    limitations:
      - Counts accounts, not money. MRR churn is churned_mrr_eur on analytics.mrr_summary_monthly.
      - An account that leaves and returns inside one quarter counts by its end state.
    expected_q2_2026:
      starting_accounts: 40
      churned_accounts: 4
      logo_churn_rate_pct: 10.0
